scope: Inventory and indexing only; raw asset payloads are not included in this package.
notes: All asset paths listed in the export manifest are now represented.
Uploaded instance count includes browser-created duplicate filenames such as '(1)' and '(2)'.
Distinct content hashes are not the same as useful asset count; separate export paths can intentionally contain identical bytes.
user.json is indexed as restricted account data and is not copied into this package.
